text:
Lina (Security): Quick alert: our registry scan found multiple production images that lack verified signatures and some use unpatched distro layers. This matches new supply-chain guidance tied to CVE-2026-2145 follow-ons. We need org-wide image-signing + CI verification rolled out.

raj (SRE): What's the immediate risk level? Any hits in prod?

Lina (Security): No active exploitation we've seen, but attack surface increased. Marking HIGH for externally facing services. Goal: prevent tampered images and ensure safe rollbacks.

amanda (Infra): Preferred tooling? cosign/sigstore?

Lina (Security): Standardize on cosign (Sigstore). Policy draft: 
1) All newly-built images must be signed at build time.
2) CI must verify signatures before pushing to prod registries.
3) Any prod image older than 30 days must be rebuilt and signed within 7 days.
4) Failed verification should block prod deploys (with a 48-hour soft-enforce period).

sid (Search): Search svc will need a short maintenance for rebuild+redeploy. Which signing key do we use?

Lina (Security): Use org KMS key: k8s://projects/redwood-keys/cosign-root. Request access via IAM flow (role: image-signing-admin). Keys are rotated quarterly.

amanda (Infra): I'll add a CI verify step to the shared deploy template. Example GH Actions snippet:

```
- name: Verify image signature
  run: |
    IMAGE=$GCR_IMAGE
    cosign verify --key k8s://projects/redwood-keys/cosign-root $IMAGE
```

We'll allow unsigned images for feature/* branches via a flag to ease dev workflows.

infra-bot: Opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/ci-templates/pull/142 to add cosign verify to deploy workflow.

raj (SRE): For canaries, soft-fail + alert for initial 48h to avoid bricking canaries; convert to hard-block after that.

Lina (Security): Exactly. 48h soft enforcement with alerts, then strict block. We'll run audits and send owner lists.

sid (Search): Where will the list of impacted images be posted?

security-bot: Audit queued. Generating list of unsigned images older than 30 days. Report to be posted in #eng-security/imd-report-177800. ETA ~2h.

Lina (Security): Owners will receive prioritized DMs; please acknowledge within 4h. If you cannot rebuild in time, open an ops-ticket and request a temporary allowlist from @amanda.

amanda (Infra): Global deploy workflow change scheduled tonight at 23:00 UTC to include verification. Exceptions require an ops-ticket and @amanda tag.

sid (Search): Ack 1 scheduling rebuild tomorrow morning and will sign artifacts.

raj (SRE): I'll add Prom metrics for signature verification failures and a PagerDuty rule: >5 failed deploys in 15m triggers P1.

Lina (Security): Recap: audit -> infra PR merged (tonight) -> owners lists (2h) -> 48h soft-enforce -> 7d strict for images >30d.

amanda (Infra): Pushed a helper script for builders at /infra/tools/cosign-sign.sh:

```
#!/bin/bash
IMAGE=$1
cosign sign --key k8s://projects/redwood-keys/cosign-root $IMAGE
```
Use it for automation.

raj (SRE): We'll coordinate maintenance windows for stateful services.

Lina (Security): Please ack this thread once you've: (a) rebuilt & signed, (b) opened exception ticket, or (c) scheduled the work. If unsigned images remain in prod after 7 days, we'll do an incident-style follow-up. :lock: 

sid (Search): Ack 1 rebuilt, signed, and pushing tagged images now.

infra-bot: ci-templates PR merged (#142) by amanda.

deploy-bot: Global deploy workflow updated to include cosign verification.

Lina (Security): First-pass audit shows ~85% compliance. Outstanding owners got DMs. Thanks for quick action — file blockers here or DM me. :thumbsup:
